driver-gloves-rezan-the-red.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red
driver-gloves-rezan-the-red.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

specialist-gloves-emerald-web.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web
specialist-gloves-emerald-web.desc:
Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating. The back of the gloves have been given a spiderweb pattern.

Discipline begets success

sport-gloves-blaze.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Blaze
sport-gloves-blaze.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints over a chrome base coat.

sport-gloves-occult.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Occult
sport-gloves-occult.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching.

ak-47-fuel-injector.name: AK-47 | Fuel Injector
ak-47-fuel-injector.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. The body of the rifle has been painted bright yellow and the magazine has been custom painted to look like machinery.

Live your life a quarter mag at a time

aug-commando-company.name: AUG | Commando Company
aug-commando-company.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A green hydrographic flecktarn camo pattern has been applied.

Translated, Flecktarn means "spot camouflage", or exactly what you WON'T be doing

bayonet-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Bayonet | Doppler
bayonet-doppler-phase-2.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

bayonet-slaughter.name: ★ Bayonet | Slaughter
bayonet-slaughter.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

desert-eagle-printstream.name: Desert Eagle | Printstream
desert-eagle-printstream.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been custom painted with a stark black and white design and finished with pearlescent highlights.

WHITE_1; BLACK_1; PEARLESCENT_1;

galil-ar-galigator.name: Galil AR | Galigator
galil-ar-galigator.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. An alligator and toxic symbols have been custom painted over a green and yellow base.

CHOMP! CHOMP! CHOMP!

glock-18-steel-disruption.name: Glock-18 | Steel Disruption
glock-18-steel-disruption.desc: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been covered in a metallic foil stamped with a digital disruptive pattern.

glock-18-dragon-tattoo.name: Glock-18 | Dragon Tattoo
glock-18-dragon-tattoo.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted using a dragon decal over a metallic base coat.

In a fairy tale the knight always slays the dragon... but this is the real world - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

glock-18-franklin.name: Glock-18 | Franklin
glock-18-franklin.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted using a hydrographic of American hundred-dollar bills.

Money doesn't talk... it kills

p2000-lifted-spirits.name: P2000 | Lifted Spirits
p2000-lifted-spirits.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been custom painted with a forest beneath ascending bodies.

Many lost souls do not wish to be found

survival-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Survival Knife | Damascus Steel
survival-knife-damascus-steel.desc: This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has some damascus steel parts.

paracord-knife-scorched.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Scorched
paracord-knife-scorched.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

classic-knife-scorched.name: ★ Classic Knife | Scorched
classic-knife-scorched.desc:
A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

falchion-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Gamma Doppler
falchion-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.desc: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

falchion-knife-ultraviolet.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Ultraviolet
falchion-knife-ultraviolet.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

flip-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Flip Knife | Doppler
flip-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

flip-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Flip Knife | Gamma Doppler
flip-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.desc: Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

flip-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Flip Knife | Tiger Tooth
flip-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

flip-knife-stained.name: ★ Flip Knife | Stained
flip-knife-stained.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

gut-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Gut Knife | Doppler
gut-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

karambit-blue-steel.name: ★ Karambit | Blue Steel
karambit-blue-steel.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

karambit-case-hardened.name: ★ Karambit | Case Hardened
karambit-case-hardened.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

m9-bayonet-urban-masked.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Urban Masked
m9-bayonet-urban-masked.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

shadow-daggers-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Doppler
shadow-daggers-doppler-phase-2.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

shadow-daggers-slaughter.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Slaughter
shadow-daggers-slaughter.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

skeleton-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Urban Masked
skeleton-knife-urban-masked.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

stiletto-knife-ultraviolet.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Ultraviolet
stiletto-knife-ultraviolet.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

huntsman-knife-black-laminate.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Black Laminate
huntsman-knife-black-laminate.desc: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been stonewashed and given a black laminate handle.

ursus-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Doppler
ursus-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

talon-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Talon Knife | Forest DDPAT
talon-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

m4a4-falak.name: M4A4 | Falak
m4a4-falak.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a red serpent over a tan-colored base.

The power you hold requires restraint

m4a1-s-leaded-glass.name: M4A1-S | Leaded Glass
m4a1-s-leaded-glass.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been hand painted to resemble shattered blue and orange glass.

Lethal fragility

m4a1-s-bright-water.name: M4A1-S | Bright Water
m4a1-s-bright-water.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. This memento from Seaside has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

Ours is a world of intrigue...but sometimes camouflage is meant to be seen - Booth, Arms Dealer

m4a1-s-nitro.name: M4A1-S | Nitro
m4a1-s-nitro.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has individual parts spray-painted black and tangerine orange.

Rona is as good as she thinks she is... she's just not old enough to realize she shouldn't point it out to everyone - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

mac-10-fade.name: MAC-10 | Fade
mac-10-fade.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

mac-10-stalker.name: MAC-10 | Stalker
mac-10-stalker.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with a neon blue cat and yellow and black stripes.

Here kitty, kitty...

mac-10-urban-ddpat.name: MAC-10 | Urban DDPAT
mac-10-urban-ddpat.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

mac-10-indigo.name: MAC-10 | Indigo
mac-10-indigo.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been painted solid colors in indigo, blue and grey.

Alex Kincaide, I'm sure you have many questions... please allow me to give you answers - The Phoenix and The Storyteller Part 1

mac-10-candy-apple.name: MAC-10 | Candy Apple
mac-10-candy-apple.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a red and black color scheme.

Great on cars, better on weapons

mp9-slide.name: MP9 | Slide
mp9-slide.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A hydrographic pattern of orange and brown streaks has been applied.

Who needs mud guards?

mp9-bulldozer.name: MP9 | Bulldozer
mp9-bulldozer.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a production line yellow color scheme.

This bone crusher is a devastator

mp9-dry-season.name: MP9 | Dry Season
mp9-dry-season.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. This memento from Gwalior has been spray-painted using ripped tape strips and perforated metal as stencils.

Don't worry...business is about to pick up - Booth, Arms Dealer

nova-wild-six.name: Nova | Wild Six
nova-wild-six.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. A custom paint job has been applied evoking post-apocalyptic imagery.

My gun, my rules

p250-ripple.name: P250 | Ripple
p250-ripple.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A blue-grey anodized pattern overlays a black base.

Be the pebble

p250-vino-primo.name: P250 | Vino Primo
p250-vino-primo.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been hand painted with a purple checkerboard pattern.

Your finest red

p90-death-by-kitty.name: P90 | Death by Kitty
p90-death-by-kitty.desc: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been hydro-dipped with a graphic of overlapping cat skulls.

p90-desert-warfare.name: P90 | Desert Warfare
p90-desert-warfare.desc: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted with a graphic design reminiscent of desert.

p90-blind-spot.name: P90 | Blind Spot
p90-blind-spot.desc: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been painted using a hydrographic with an oversized camouflage pattern.

r8-revolver-inlay.name: R8 Revolver | Inlay
r8-revolver-inlay.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has been custom painted to resemble acanthus engravings and a marble grip.

Opulence in the palm of your hand

scar-20-cyrex.name: SCAR-20 | Cyrex
scar-20-cyrex.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been custom painted with a high-tech design in black, white, and red.

Sebastien is coming for me Valeria... we don't have much time - Chase Turner, Coalition Defector

scar-20-outbreak.name: SCAR-20 | Outbreak
scar-20-outbreak.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been painted with vibrant shades of green.

Valeria is getting bolder... the time has come to take the fight to her - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

sg-553-atlas.name: SG 553 | Atlas
sg-553-atlas.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been given a modern camouflage hydrographic.

It was once a design earmarked for the Coalition Taskforce, but Huxley engaged in corporate espionage to make it a Phoenix exclusive

ssg-08-threat-detected.name: SSG 08 | Threat Detected
ssg-08-threat-detected.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. A custom paint job of a map pattern overlayed with a bird's eye HUD has been applied.

Target acquired

tec-9-fuel-injector.name: Tec-9 | Fuel Injector
tec-9-fuel-injector.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. The body has been painted yellow and the magazine has been given a belt engine hydrographic.  A hand-stitched leather grip completes this Seattle classic.

Pit crew not included

tec-9-raw-ceramic.name: Tec-9 | Raw Ceramic
tec-9-raw-ceramic.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted a solid tan color.

Restore by force

tec-9-sultan.name: Tec-9 | Sultan
tec-9-sultan.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been custom painted with arabesque-inspired mosaic designs.

Ceasefire through increased fire

usp-s-desert-tactical.name: USP-S | Desert Tactical
usp-s-desert-tactical.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with an olive-colored tactical camouflage.

Base models don't have to be boring

usp-s-pc-grn.name: USP-S | PC-GRN
usp-s-pc-grn.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with a minty green and silver-colored design.

The Glass of Fate is half-full

huntsman-knife.name: ★ Huntsman Knife
huntsman-knife.desc: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces.
